summary: Second pass on the 3 reorder holes (eps 111, 120, 227). Eps 111 and 120 are two-part episodes whose fandom pages carry TWO Episode Box infoboxes; the first harvest read only the first box (chapters=N/A, the anime-original Part A) and missed the Part B boxes, which map 111B to Lesson 172 and 120B to Lesson 187 — both full 19-page chapters (not slivers), confirmed by fandom Lesson-page reverse mappings (172→111B v20, 187→120B v22), exact ja-title matches in Wikipedia's List of Gintama chapters (v20=L167-175, v22=L185-193), and Syoboi Calendar's as-aired two-part subtitles (TID 853 #111/#120). This also falsifies the first pass's never-adapted list on exactly 172 and 187. Ep 227 adapts the Gintama×Sket Dance crossover special (fandom "Lesson 360.1"; Wikipedia: unnumbered "Special Lesson" コラボにはエイリアンVSプレデターがあるのも覚えておけ closing volume 41 after L360, tankobon released 2011-09-02) — the whole episode, exact title match with the as-aired #227 subtitle (Syoboi/official bn-pictures story page; anime censors エイリ○ンVSプ×デター). It is anchored at the special's collected slot, 360/360 v41 in ruled integer Lesson space; mainline L360 (Renho Arc, serialized 2011-07-11) belongs to ep 236 as already stored. All three anchors are deliberately non-monotonic against their neighbors (111: L172 between eps at L193-194/L183; 120: L187 between L202/L189-190; 227: special@360.1 between L342/L347) — reorder regime handles the rendering.
